title: Personal Training Packages: how many packages a member may hold open at once
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the limit on how many personal-training packages a single member may hold open at the same time.

## Rule
A member may hold up to 2 personal-training packages open at the same time, counting any package whose status is other than closed; for example, a member may hold a standard package alongside one specialty add-on. A third concurrent open package is not permitted. In addition, a member may not hold two Unlimited Monthly Coaching packages open at the same time, regardless of how many total open packages that would represent.

## Points of judgement
A package counts toward this limit for as long as its status is anything other than closed -- that includes a package that is merely applied for, active, paused, exhausted, or expired, and stops counting only once the package reaches closed status. So a member holding one active package and one paused package already holds 2 open packages and may not open a third, even though neither of the two has been used up or cancelled. A member who already holds one Unlimited Monthly Coaching package open may not open a second Unlimited Monthly Coaching package, even if doing so would not by itself exceed the overall count of 2.
